chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā narrated from Aḥmad ibn ʿUmar al-Ḥallāl, who said: Yāsir said, from some of the servants, from Abī al-Ḥasan عليه السلام.
That he said: “The servant continues to steal until, when he has fully taken the price of his hand, Allah exposes him for it.”

key_terms.أَظْهَرَهُ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ: Allah exposes him for it and makes his crime manifest
key_terms.الْعَبْدُ: the servant; the human being addressed in a morally accountable state
key_terms.ثَمَنَ يَدِهِ: the price of his hand; meaning the consequence warranting the legal penalty upon the hand

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith describe the consequence of repeatedly committing theft?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that persistent theft eventually leads a person to the point where the consequence of the crime becomes deserved, and then Allah brings the matter to light. It conveys a moral warning about ongoing wrongdoing and its eventual exposure and punishment.
